Images.Caption: A screenshot from Age of Empires: Definitive Edition showcasing a large ancient Mesoamerican  city. It is surrounded by sand, patches of grass, groupings of palm trees, a small body of water toward the upper right and two long strips of water at the upper left. The city is filled with two civilizations. There are red units on foot and on horseback. There are also yellow units on foot as well as on the back of war elephants.

An in-game screenshot from Age of Empires: Definitive Edition shows a large naval battle with over 15 ships in beautiful turquoise waters along a shoreline. There are two ships within the center of the battle that are on fire. Calvary troops, mangonels and other units are gathered along the shore. A small HUD map is displayed in the lower right corner of the image. The top left corner lists the types of resources, and the total acquired. The top-center of the image lists, "IV IRON AGE".

Screenshot from Age of Empires: Definitive Edition depicting a desert scene. Palm trees burst through the sand across different sections of the map. A large army of blue units, including war elephants, amassed outside of a yellow stronghold. Yellow archers are stationed near tall stone walls, along a cliff with a rocky facade. The yellow units prepare for a charge from a small group of blue units. A small HUD map is featured on the bottom right of the image. Resources appear on the upper left of the image. At the top center of the image lists, "IV IRON AGE".

Screenshot from Age of Empires: Definitive Edition depicting a forested scene. A long stretch of land is framed on the left, and at the top, by a large body of turquoise water. Along the upper left of the shore sits a harbor with fishing boats near it. There is an opening of land from the shoreline to the right of the image. The right is framed by thick groupings of trees. There are two buildings on either side of the clearing, with two outposts just slightly south of them. Slightly north, at the center of this clearing, is a fountain with four pagodas framing it. Resources show at the top left of the screen and a small HUD map is shown on the lower right corner. The top center of the image lists, "III BRONZE AGE".

Screenshot from the game Age of Empires: Definitive Edition depicting a desert scene with a small body of water near the center. The body of water is surrounded by numerous Mesoamerican style buildings that are framed by long tall stone walls. The right side of the ancient city runs along the edge of a cliff with a rocky facade. Several units can be seen on foot and horseback throughout the city. A few groupings of palm trees appear throughout the scene. Resources appear at the top left of the image. A small HUD map appears at the lower right of the image. At the top center of the image lists, "IV IRON AGE".

LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription:
Age of Empires, the pivotal RTS that launched a 20-year legacy returns in definitive form for Windows 10 PCs. Bringing together all of the officially released content with modernized gameplay, all-new visuals and a host of other new features, Age of Empires: Definitive Edition is the complete RTS package. Engage in over 40 hours of updated campaign content with new narration and pacing, jump online in up to 8-player battles with new competitive features and modes, experience 4K HD visuals with overhauled animations, get creative with the scenario builder and share your creations. There’s never been a better time to jump in to Age of Empires. Welcome back to history.















* Requires a free Xbox Live account.
LocalizedProperties.ShortDescription: Age of Empires, the pivotal real-time strategy game that launched a 20-year legacy returns with modernized gameplay, all-new 4K visuals, 8-person multiplayer battles and a host of other new features.  Welcome back to history.
